usage: Illustrative ambient imagery, not documented Grand Hill work.
shared: Photorealistic architectural editorial photograph; natural Florida daylight; restrained white, gray, charcoal and warm wood; defining detail in central crop band; no people, logos, text, watermark or collage.

images.prompt: An empty freshly painted office corridor, soft muted sage walls with crisp white doorframes, soft daylight, wall paint is focal point, no retail fixtures.
Finished Florida low-rise commercial exterior, pale sand painted facade, deep charcoal trim, broad facade at oblique angle, blue sky and restrained palms, no close stucco detail.

Close view of an interior drywall wall being prepared: several neatly feathered pale joint-compound patches and a broad smooth primed area, grazing daylight showing surface flatness, tidy floor edge, no tools.

A clean furnished office lobby with reception desk, seating and a corridor, neatly protected adjacent work zone with clear temporary protective film over one chair and floor edge, finished neutral walls, no people or signs.
Extreme architectural close-up of warm ivory textured stucco facade with precise recessed control joint and corner, tactile finish in grazing sunlight, no full building or windows.
Close view of pressure washer lance spraying a fan of water across exterior stone pavers beside a commercial entrance, visible wet texture and realistic restrained spray, no people.

Macro architectural photo of a continuous neat gray silicone sealant bead between a charcoal aluminum window frame and pale masonry, joint runs diagonally through central frame, precise water-resistant finish, no tools.
Low-angle view across a finished satin light-gray protective epoxy floor in a clean small commercial utility room, subtle reflected daylight, neat coved wall-to-floor transition, no tools.
Close interior architectural view of installed charcoal-gray woven-texture wallcovering, precise seam and clean edge at warm wood doorway, natural side light reveals fabric grain, no furniture focus.

Low-angle architectural view of installed alternating warm gray commercial carpet tiles in empty office, accurate seams and subtle textile texture, distant glass partitions, flooring dominates two thirds of frame.

Close architectural view of a neatly repaired smooth off-white interior wall beside a securely installed brushed-metal display bracket and warm wood shelf, discreet feathered primer patch below shelf showing repair scope, no tools.

Medium architectural view centered on a newly installed freestanding retail cashwrap counter, oak veneer and white solid-surface top with precise joints, clean modest empty shop, no products or branding, counter dominates.

Strong perspective view along a repeating row of identical installed modular retail shelving bays in an empty store, charcoal uprights and pale wood shelves, exact alignment and consistent spacing, no counter focus.
